people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Hermon_Mount
people.line: Mountain on the northern border of Israel

people.name: Manasseh
people.line: Firstborn son of Joseph, blessed by Jacob.

translations.web: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land: they increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.
translations.bsb: Now the people of the half-tribe of Manasseh were numerous. They settled in the land from Bashan to Baal-hermon (that is, Senir, also known as Mount Hermon).
translations.kjv: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baalhermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
translations.asv: And the children of the half-tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir and mount Hermon.
